## Orientation

Work in /home/ayin/se-workflow. Two parallel executors build the other two rollups. Own only scripts/effort_rollup.py and tests/test_effort_rollup.py. Input rows are JSON dicts shaped like the output of scripts/session_report.py --records. Scripts import each other as top-level modules, but this module needs no other script. Do not edit .artifacts/, other scripts or other tests.
